items.rationale: Cost of establishing cause and extent under 5.2.6(b) is covered whether or not repair follows, up to EUR 3,000, so the assessment is indemnified even with gradual leakage.

items.description: Indoor leak detection incl. technician and vehicle
items.rationale: Leak location under 5.2.6(a) with technician time is covered up to EUR 1,000 and the single vehicle charge is admitted under 5.2.6(c), regardless of gradual cause.

items.description: Floor covering removal incl. linoleum, skirting, prep and waste disposal
items.rationale: Porous-pipe leakage is gradual under 7.1.10, so the moisture damage to the building is not escape of water damage and removal of floor finishes and debris is not indemnified.
Provisioning for a contractor's own personnel is business outlay under 7.1.8(b), and in any case not a repair cost.

items.description: Technical drying incl. labour, dust protection and kitchen disinfection
items.rationale: Under 7.1.10 drying measures under 7.1.7 and the related costs are not indemnified for gradual leakage, and the disinfection is likewise a consequence of moisture damage not covered.
Drying is not indemnified for gradual leakage under 7.1.10, and separately metered utility charges are excluded under 7.1.7 in any event.
